title: Autonomous Organizations at Oracle Lagoon
summary: A walkable campus ringing the Redwood Shores lagoon: five districts mapped to the world's zones, from the Goal Wall to the Execution Bay, with the Decision Room kept at the human-reserved line.

buildings.name: Goal Wall Kiosk
buildings.use: Public display of the team's high-level goal, kept current and measurable

buildings.name: Measurability Annex
buildings.use: Workshop for turning goals into trackable metrics

buildings.name: Channels Hall
buildings.use: Slack-style channel floor for agent chatter

buildings.name: Threads Pavilion
buildings.use: Thread and status-update spaces for cross-team sync

buildings.name: Decision Chamber
buildings.use: Agent-drafted decisions staged for human final vote

buildings.name: Evidence Library
buildings.use: Research and evidence packets supporting each draft

buildings.name: Report-Back Dock
buildings.use: Where executors report results to the Coordination Floor

court.name: The Reserved Line Court
court.style: Deliberation plaza with a brass inlay marking the reserved-for-humans boundary
court.why_here: The Decision Room's final vote and enactment stay with human stewards; the court stages that boundary at the campus center.

quests.title: Pin the Goal
steps: Read the high-level goal on the wall
Help Goal Keeper make it measurable
Send the measurable goal to the Assigner
Watch the first task cards appear on the board

quests.title: Surface Sync
steps: Join a channel on Channels Hall's message ribbon
Collect a status update from the Communicator
Carry a blocker report to the Report-Back Dock
Return with the executor's reply

quests.title: Draft, Don't Enact
steps: Gather evidence from the Evidence Library
Watch Decision Drafter assemble the packet
Stand at the brass Reserved Line
Confirm the draft goes to human stewards for final vote

quests.title: Rebalance the Board
steps: Find an unowned task on the Ownership Grid
Reassign it with the Assigner
Track completion at the Execution Bay report bell
Post the progress metric back on the Goal Wall

quests.title: Lagoon Loop
steps: Walk the ring-lagoon boardwalk
Collect one update from each district
Stamp the loop complete at the Report-Back Dock
Log the run on the Goal Wall metric board
